copies.title: Du brief client à la proposition commerciale avec ChatGPT
copies.summary: Six modules rédigés pour cadrer une demande fictive, préparer une instruction, rédiger et contrôler une proposition, puis adapter sa méthode à un second dossier. M01 fournit une première activité gratuite autonome. Les supports actuellement produits sont des textes et ressources Markdown ; le format commercial reste à valider.

copies.title: From client brief to a clear proposal with ChatGPT
copies.summary: Six written modules to scope a fictional request, prepare an instruction, draft and check a proposal, then adapt the method to a second case. M01 provides a complete free activity. The material currently produced is text and Markdown resources; the commercial delivery format still needs approval.

assessment: Explained quizzes and self-reported project assessment. No human review or official certification.
activationBlockers: Validate human editorial and FR/EN meaning equivalence review.
Decide the actual delivery format; do not silently replace a video promise with a text-only offer.
Provide real price, currency, tax presentation, access, updates, support, legal terms, refunds and retention decisions.
Decide sales languages independently of the authored translations.
Produce and verify any media promised by the eventual offer.
Resolve the release gate for the historical P12/P15 access incidents before delivering the commercial flow.
